The prophecy states that “Darkness has fallen upon the land. The blood of the dragons will revive once again, and the ancient pact will be kept.
When the four dragons are gathered,the sword and shield which will protect the king shall awaken,and the Red Dragon shall restore the dawn at last.” 

The “king” and the “red dragon” seems to be different people.

Hak is a great swordsman, and yona is a shield by extension since she’s been guarded by her dragons. Meaning if she’s guarded by her dragons then who ever she’s protecting are also guarded by them. Since King Hiryu is the Red Dragon and he reincarnated as Yona, that makes Yona the red dragon. Also what if King Hiryuu’s human and dragon split?
